question: Why did the OCR merge (R-010) get refused on most stores?
symptom: store_repair refused the R-010 pages repair: fin_quarter_printed rows from scanned pages are removed and some have no same-value row after (c05 12, c07 3, c08 1, c09 12, c20 4, c21 1). Most removed rows are wrong parses of a jumbled text layer (e.g. GAYAPROJ FY25 standalone total income 3,46,572.20 lakh), but a few look right (SPMLINFRA Q3FY25 PBT 126,517 thousand from 'Profi/lloss) before Excaptional ltems').
cause: Once a page has OCR text the printed-table parser reads only that text; a line the OCR splits or misreads gives no row, and the layer row it replaced is gone.
missing: A rule for printed rows on pages with both a jumbled layer and OCR: which source leads, and whether a layer row the OCR does not reproduce survives when it passes the checks.
fix: Proposed: parse both; OCR rows lead on a jumbled page; keep a layer row for a (period, basis, line) the OCR misses only if it passes row_checks (reconciles with its siblings); log every layer/OCR value conflict, as kpi does since R-010.
next: Write the rule in the comparatives part with a test on c07 p5 and c20 p7; re-run the refused stores and accept only with zero right rows lost. Until then those stores keep their as-built rows.
kind_why: pages with a jumbled text layer: rows built from them may be lost or wrong, and the OCR repair that would fix them changes printed rows, so 69 repairs wait for a hand-read

question: Trial 1: KABRAEXTRU FY26 PAT, SIMPLEXINF FY24 order book, NSIL PE

Before it, a nearby scale word made the checker skip the page-unit test without comparing. c04 (SIMPLEXINF) re-run: order book FY24 now 20000 inr_mn (2,000 crore), revenue FY24 10109 standalone / 13885 consolidated inr_mn recovered as verified, 0 rows removed. KABRAEXTRU FY26 pat (FY25 column), NSIL PE and NAVKARCORP's JSW deck are still open.
